zh: 修复 Codex 轮次暂未就绪时实时引导退回队列后不再送入的问题；保留发送意图，就绪后自动投递，未确认成功的消息不会重复重试。
移除输入框里的关联项目入口。
Codex 默认使用 GPT-6-Astra 和低（low）思考等级，自动接续采用相同默认值。
en: Preserve live-guidance requests while a Codex turn is starting and deliver them when ready. Messages with uncertain delivery remain held instead of being replayed.
Remove the linked-project control from the composer.
Default Codex and automatic continuation to GPT-6-Astra with low reasoning effort.
